A panel with six common landforms shown as contour patterns. 1. A conical hill (concentric circular contours). 2. A plateau (contours close at the edges, wide empty space in the middle). 3. A ridge (long oval contours). 4. An escarpment (contours close together on one side, far apart on the other). 5. A valley (V-shaped contours pointing towards the higher contour values, with a blue river line in the middle). 6. A spur (V-shaped contours pointing towards the lower contour values). Clean flat textbook illustration, white background, clear contour numbers to show uphill/downhill directions.

Three side-by-side diagrams showing slopes and intervisibility. Left: A concave slope (gentle at the bottom, steep at the top). Two stick figures at the top and bottom with a straight dashed line of sight connecting them uninterrupted. Middle: A convex slope (steep at the bottom, gentle at the top). The dashed line of sight between the top and bottom is blocked by the bulge of the hill. Right: Two peaks with a higher ridge in between, blocking the line of sight. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A cross-profile drawing process. Top: A topographical map with a line A-B crossing a hill. A straight-edged strip of paper is laid along A-B, with tick marks where contours cross it. Bottom: A graph with a horizontal axis A-B and a vertical axis showing height in metres. The tick marks from the paper are projected upwards to their corresponding heights, and a smooth curve joins them to show a hill profile. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A hypothetical topographical map extract showing physical and human relationships. A meandering river flows through a wide valley (widely spaced contours). A nucleated settlement (cluster of black squares) sits on gently sloping ground away from the river's flood plain (dry point). A linear settlement runs along a main road that follows the valley parallel to the river. A bridge crosses the river where the road meets it. Steep hills (closely spaced contours) are forested (green tree symbols) and have no settlements. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
